note: External UCS-2 encoded document bytes are decoded into FilterChar array; each UCS-2 char becomes one FilterChar with width=1
Token length is computed as character count (sum of widths=1 per char), not byte count; for 3 UCS-2 chars this yields tok.len=3
Convert::convert passes the raw size parameter (token.len=3, a character count) directly to DecodeDirect<Uni16>::decode as byte length

code: const Chr * stop = reinterpret_cast<const Chr *>(in0 + size);
note: stop is computed as in0 + size(=3 odd bytes) then cast to Uni16*; since Uni16 pointer increments by 2 bytes, the loop pointer can never equal this misaligned stop address
Loop reads past the heap buffer indefinitely because in (incrementing by 2) never equals misaligned stop, causing heap-buffer-overflow READ 2
